label: the beast
note: IP-neutral. Issue #220: a planet's beast, a giant armoured beetle-centipede (issue #266) that crawls about its desert: a beetle's head with mandibles, horn, antennae and glowing eyes, and a long body of segments, each with a pair of legs, that follows the head's path. Touching the head or any segment kills. These are the defaults every beast shares; a planet has one only if its own file (content/core/planets/<id>.json) has a "beast" block, which gives it a name, a home spot, what the locals say of it, and may override any number here. Touch it (on foot, or ride a speeder into it) and you die on the spot. It wanders with no pull toward or away from the town, in long curves (turn_radius_m typical, never tighter than min_turn_radius_m, so its body never coils over itself; chase_turn_radius_m in a chase), and only a loose leash round its home spot turns it back. If it still ends up milling about one spot (over stuck_window_s it gets less than stuck_net_frac of the way it walked), it walks out, away from where it has been, for unstick_s. Its look: the parts' colours, look.stone (the weathered-rock shell, beast_shell.gdshader: strata, cracks, lumps, sand) and look.eyes (glow, white-hot core, slit pupil, light, pulse, brighter in a chase). Hurt it and it chases you until you are chase_give_up_m away; it has hp health and stays dead once killed (WorldState flag beast_slain_<planet id>). Now and then it farts. The town's locals know it: walk close by one, calm, and now and then they say one of the planet's lore lines (every locals_say_every_s at most, read by src/systems/npc/townsfolk.gd); every AI character is briefed on it (PlanetBeast.brief). {name} in a line is the planet's name for it. Read by src/systems/world/planet_beast.gd.

lines.woke: You wake up in the pit, still smelling {name}.
lines.slain: {name} curls up and goes still. The locals won't believe it.
